scope: Feasibility spike: all learned affine maps in a tiny causal Transformer come from one shared tensor and one scalar Mirror address per role. Not a capacity or speed claim.

interpretations.primary: one shared 64x64 learnable core plus 14 scalar role addresses; every embedding/Q/K/V/O/FFN/readout matrix is a cropped orthogonal conjugate of that core
interpretations.literal_scalar_control: exactly one trainable scalar, frozen random core included in stored bytes; all 14 roles have fixed offsets plus that scalar

architecture.rotation: one scalar angle, adjacent Givens planes with deterministic integer frequencies 1..32; same angle controls left and right orthogonal conjugation

dense_byte.note: 4128 independent scalars vs candidate 4110; actual compact inference bytes measured, not padded

tasks.copy: 15 independent symbols 0..7 followed by public query specifying lag 1..4; predict the selected earlier symbol
tasks.retrieve: 8 unique keys with random 4-valued labels, shuffled composite key/value tokens, 7 pads, public key query; predict label

worlds.meaning: independent random input vocabulary encodings of the same two symbolic task families

data_separation: independent seeded torch.Generators for online train and heldout evaluation; protocol and source hash frozen before fresh worlds; no fresh tuning or early stopping
minimum_trials: 3 worlds x 2 seeds per model/task = 72 complete trials

gates.structural: only core and one scalar per role trainable in mirror; scalar_only exactly one trainable scalar; finite nonzero gradients; causal prefix unchanged within 1e-6; exact serialized reload logits
gates.learning: per task, candidate median heldout accuracy >=0.75 and median heldout query NLL <=0.70 of initialization; report task-wise pass, and pass-both separately
gates.superiority: NOT a primary gate; report simple shared/gain and byte-near dense controls without promoting fixed-update wins to capacity or Pareto proofs

accounting: unique learned scalars, frozen scalars, logical matrix elements, raw state bytes, actual torch.save compact inference bytes, optimizer updates, examples/tokens, forward dense MAC proxy, 3x training MAC proxy, wall time, median/p10/p90 CPU inference time; transforms/nonlinear kernels explicitly not included in dense MAC proxy
deviations_from_full_MA1162_plan: only two causal query tasks for user-requested minimal feasibility
no K/T sweep, no DB, no controller, no corpus LM
no equal-training-FLOP or equal-time claim; fixed-update spike only
existing L1 results and registry statuses are preserved; subexperiment not a new MA hypothesis
negative_outcome_policy: keep all results; underperformance of this one-parameter orbit does not falsify all Mirror representations
